user.title: Connect your vehicles
user.description:
Get a **personal** API key from [Pleos Playground]({pleos_url}) → account menu → **My Vehicle Data API** → select manufacturer → **Get API Key** → sign into your manufacturer account. [Step-by-step guide]({key_guide_url}).

Select the same manufacturer below and paste both credentials. Keys must be replaced manually when they expire; check the expiry shown in Pleos. Only data shared by your vehicle will appear.

data_description.client_id: Copy the Client ID from My Vehicle Data API in Pleos Playground.
data_description.client_secret: Copy the matching Client Secret. Home Assistant saves it in its private configuration.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Generate a new personal key and enter both matching fields for this manufacturer.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read your vehicles from Pleos. Check your internet connection and personal API availability, then try again.
error.rate_limited: Pleos is limiting requests. Wait a few minutes before trying again.

abort.already_configured: This manufacturer is already configured. Use Reconfigure on its existing entry to replace the key.

init.title: Vehicle data options
init.description: More frequent polling does not make the car upload sooner. Valid last-reported values stay visible while the car is parked. The stale-data threshold marks older readings with data_stale; it does not make them unavailable. Options reload this integration automatically.

data.location: Enable location data and GPS tracking
data.trip_events: Fire an event for each new trip

data_description.location: Queries the location endpoint and exposes its data. A map tracker is created only for valid WGS84 coordinates.
data_description.trip_events: Fires pleos_vehicle_data_trip once per trip with every sample the API returned. Large trips can be excluded from the recorder.
data_description.trip_poll_minutes: How often the four trip endpoints are queried. Pleos delivers trip data with a delay, so this can be longer than the polling interval. Trip readings are kept between queries.
